summary.intent: Diagnose and fix a failing lint CI job on PR #455 in the cipher-box repository caused by a pnpm install error.
summary.outcome: Added `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` to `package.json` to whitelist the 6 packages requiring build scripts, resolving the pnpm v10 compatibility issue, and committed the fix directly to the PR #455 branch.

repo: cipher-box uses pnpm with --frozen-lockfile in CI, meaning lockfile changes are not tolerated during install
The repo had no explicit pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies config, which became required after upgrading to pnpm v10+
Two telemetry packages (@nestjs/core, @scarf/scarf) are intentionally excluded from build script allowlist

code.finding: Added pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies array listing: esbuild, argon2, bufferutil, utf-8-validate, msgpackr-extract, protobufjs — the native addons and binary-fetching packages that legitimately need postinstall scripts

workflow: pnpm v10+ no longer auto-runs dependency build scripts; packages must be explicitly approved via pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies in package.json or .npmrc
The fix only required a package.json change — no lockfile regeneration needed
When applying a fix to a PR branch, stash local changes, fetch and checkout the PR branch, then re-apply the edit before committing

friction: The CI error message listed package names but not which were safe to exclude, requiring manual judgment to identify telemetry-only packages vs. necessary native addons
open_items: @nestjs/core and @scarf/scarf build scripts are suppressed — if any @nestjs/core postinstall behavior is ever needed, this will need revisiting
Worth confirming CI passes on PR #455 after the commit lands to close the loop
